newsitem.title: USA: CSX files plan for integrating Conrail lines.
newsitem.headline: CSX files plan for integrating Conrail lines.

text.p: CSX Corp, which is seeking regulatory approval to buy East Coast railroad Conrail Inc for $10.3 billion in a joint transaction with Norfolk Southern Corp, said Monday it had filed an operating plan for integrating Conrail's rail lines into its system.

The plan, part of a joint application with Norfolk Southern that CSX filed with the U.S. Surface Transportation Board, includes $488 million in capital improvements throughout the CSX system and details service enhancements and more than $500 million of "public benefits" arising from the expanded route network, CSX said.

The plan also details $410 million in net revenue gains and cost savings that are expected. Of this amount, $264 million is expected from cost savings and $146 million from net revenue gains, CSX said.

It said the new cost savings and revenue projections, higher than earlier estimates of $165 million and $75 million, respectively, were due to more detailed analysis of Conrail operations and the synergies and growth opportunities expected from the deal.
CSX said the plan designates 12 service routes that will link major geographic regions and traffic gateways throughout its 23,000 route-mile system with single-line service.
It said the more efficient route network will reduce delays, switching and interchange of freight rail cars between route railroads, and speed service to customers.
A spokeswoman for CSX said the more than $500 million in "public benefits" arise from such broad categories as shipper logistic benefits, savings in highway costs, and lower operating expenses.

Shippers will benefit from doing business with a single-line service as opposed to dealing with more than one carrier, the spokeswoman said, and highway maintenance costs will be reduced because more trucks will be taken off the roads as truck traffic gets diverted to rails.

She also said lower operating expenses at CSX as a result of the Conrail merger will ultimately result in cost savings for the public. "Savings at CSX will allow us to provide more cost-efficient transportation to our shippers.... which will have a ripple effect into benefiting the public."
